answer: Coordination Salt Auction. Each epoch the protocol mints a single-use "comet" nonce per agent slot and auctions salts binding nonces to identities. Validators accept an action only if its salt derives from a nonce verified unused, enforced via a cedar-anchored nullifier set. An attacker coordinating N sock puppets must win N distinct salts, each priced by a Vickrey auction whose reserve scales with concurrent registrations. Genuine agents amortize one salt across many actions using a quill-signed delegation chain, while sybils pay the marginal clearing price per identity.
